controlled_features: Four deterministic transforms of one graph-Gaussian field per base graph: Gaussian, centered/scaled exponential, bimodal sign-plus-linear, heavy polynomial. K=.35*11T+.65*diag-normalized inverse(I-rho*S), rho drawn U(.5,.9). No feature ID or style ID is supplied to the model.
controlled_labels: Four independent stochastic binary rules from complete X and G: self-linear, L2-normalized neighbor-linear, product of two linear projections, normalized two-hop contrast. Weights, bias, flip and Bernoulli noise drawn independently of feature-style ID. No sample-quantile threshold or class-balance rejection. Both binary classes remain in the output space even when one is absent in a realized graph/context.
coupling_control: Each base graph appears with all 4 feature styles. Coupled uses rule=style. Crossed uses rule=(style+floor(graph_id/4)%4)%4. Train graph IDs cover all combinations uniformly. Each base graph's feature realizations and rule-parameter instances have exactly the same marginal exposure counts in both arms. Mask slot=(style+graph_id%4)%4 makes the feature-style/rule/mask Cartesian product balanced in crossed. One graph/update; no paired loss or batching benefit. Class-balanced context selection is a separate declared observation protocol, not a theorem of separability for graph rows.
official_reference: Fresh size/feature/binary-restricted official GraphPFN graph_then_attributes prior, original feature/label mechanism and quantile conversion retained. Official vs controlled changes the generator family as well as coupling, so only coupled vs crossed isolates the finite-bank coupling intervention.
test: All arms see identical test inputs. 32 fresh base graphs. Controlled: style=graph_id%4, diagonal rule plus one off-diagonal rule with shift=1+floor(graph_id/4)%3. Official: native task on the same base graph draw. All test settings fixed before training. This is new graph/function seeds within specified families, not unseen semantic schema or real-graph validation.
model: Same public GraphPFN Mask Plain, same trainable/frozen parameters. Routing modifies feature-group key/value access only; label-token keys always context C. Native feature group is a pair of coordinates; observed-only selects group iff at least one real coordinate observed, retains two-bit mask. Null all-zero key/value allowed only if group has no observations. Padding never counts as observed evidence. No upstream file changes.
information_check: Reuse restricted known-rule Gaussian sign information check without filtering tasks. C-only base attention restriction is verified but is NOT assumed to be the cause of previous failures.
interventions: Secondary clustered90 official and off-diagonal: remove all observations or shuffle observed rows. Model input never includes query truth. No extra sampling ensembles.
sampling_controls: No random-fill ensemble in this pilot; prior frozen random-fill results remain a separate record.
gates: Primary accuracy: average official and controlled off-diagonal whole-node uniform/clustered 90/99.5 conditions, equal weight by family/rate/mechanism, paired 64 base graphs, fixed three training seeds. Mechanism gate: observed > context and observed > all_nodes, both graph CI lower>0. Strong-method gate additionally requires observed > PCFI and observed > LP, both CI lower>0. NLL/Brier/full/cell/diagonal reported separately; no NLL requirement hidden inside accuracy primary. Effects that fail main gate are preserved with their scope.
statistics: 5000 base-graph paired bootstrap after averaging three fixed seeds and prespecified settings within graph. Primary family aggregate selected before training. Family/mask subgroups secondary, no multiplicity-adjusted claims. Last checkpoint only; no test selection. Fresh graph seeds, same declared generator families; no real graph/unseen schema claim.
train_stream: Alternating official_mask and crossed_mask streams from the newly drawn bank: 512 logical updates, identical permutation and initial parameters across four arms. No paired loss, no extra head or auxiliary objective. PCFI is trained with actual PCFI input.
